description: Instrumentation UI test suite for MainActivity of an Android app, using Espresso framework. The tests verify form validation, submission, list updates, theming, and toast messages.

classes.name: MainActivityUiTest
classes.description: Test suite class containing multiple UI tests for MainActivity

methods.name: form_validation_enablesButtonOnlyWhenBothFieldsHaveText
methods.description: Tests that the submit button is only enabled when both input fields have text.

methods.name: submit_addsItem_clearsFields_showsSuccessToast_andListOrdersLatestFirst
methods.description: Tests the form submission process, success toast, clearing of input fields, and correct ordering in the feedback list.

methods.name: invalid_submit_showsErrorToast_andNoListChange
methods.description: Verifies that submitting with invalid data shows an error toast and does not update the list.

methods.name: theme_button_hasPrimaryTint
methods.description: Checks that the submit button and related UI elements have the correct theming and styling.

methods.name: scenarioOnDecorView
methods.description: Utility method to capture the decor view for matching Toast messages.

methods.name: listHasCount
methods.description: Helper matcher to verify the number of items in a ListView.

methods.name: listItemTextAtPosition
methods.description: Helper matcher to verify the text inside a specific list item at a given position.

methods.name: listItemVisibilityAtPosition
methods.description: Helper matcher to verify visibility of a specific view within a list item at a given position.
